name: tabbit
description: A dependency-free Chrome extension for native tab grouping and session cleanup.

scripts.check: node --check src/ai-config.js && node --check src/organizer.js && node --check src/workspace.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/newtab.js && node --check src/newtab-settings.js && node --check src/discovery.js && node --check src/discovery-view.js
scripts.validate: node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8'))" && npm run check && npm test
